task.title: Fortier - Task Alpha
task.shortdesc: This task describes the procedure for calibrating the HV-1000 sensor to ensure accurate data collection. Proper calibration is required after initial installation, following a firmware update, or if anomalous readings are detected. Completing this process requires the calibration tool kit (PN: CAL-KIT-55B).

prereq.p: Calibration of the HV-1000 sensor requires the following.

ul.li: The HV-1000 sensor powered on and in a ready state.
Approximately five minutes of uninterrupted time to complete the process.
The system software updated to version 2.1 or later.

context.p: Calibration aligns the HV-1000 sensor's internal measurements with known standard values. This process is critical for maintaining data integrity and ensuring compliance with quality assurance protocols. The task involves using a calibrated reference device from the tool kit to send a stable signal, which the HV-1000 then uses to auto-adjust its internal settings.
The entire process typically takes less than five minutes to complete and does not require a system reboot. You must have Operator-level access permissions or higher to perform this calibration.

p.b: Perform the calibration in the following order:

ol.li: Locate the calibration port on the lower panel of the HV-1000 sensor.
Connect the reference device from the CAL-KIT-55B firmly into the calibration port.
On the main system interface, navigate to Settings > Maintenance > Sensor Calibration.
Select HV-1000 from the list of available devices.
Wait for the status indicator to change from blinking amber to solid green. Do not interrupt power during this process.
After the process completes, disconnect the reference device from the calibration port.

Verify the calibration was successful by checking that the "Calibration Status" field on the sensor's main screen reads OK. Status Indicators
Status Light Color State Meaning Required Action
Power Green Solid Device is ready None. Proceed with task
Calibration Amber Blinking Calibration in progress Do not interrupt power or disconnect device
Calibration Green Solid Calibration complete Disconnect reference device
Calibration Red Solid Calibration failed Restart procedure
System fault Red Blinking An error has occurred Abort the task and contact system support
